title: Constructive notice of dedication.
bodyText: The filed map or plat and the recorded certificate of dedication shall constitute constructive notice to all persons of the dedication of the property to cemetery purposes.
bodyHtml: §441-7  Constructive notice of dedication.  The filed map or plat and the recorded certificate of dedication shall constitute constructive notice to all persons of the dedication of the property to cemetery purposes. [L 1967, c 199, pt of §1; HRS §441-7]
